verdict.rationale: Slack's huddles page says AI takes notes during huddles, organizing key takeaways, action items and who said what when the huddle ends. The AI features page separately says AI can take meeting notes and serve daily recaps of channels and threads. missing for 10: explicit evidence that people who missed a huddle can access the recap, detail on how notes are delivered or shared, coverage of meetings outside huddles, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
